Bright hello desk staff,
Thanks for a hardworking day; the kennel attendant raised a reminder about hand-off notes

Please keep the companion files tidy and direct, since our records must support calm service and steady follow-through. <<FACT F085>> Where a traveler has a change in route or crate details, note it in clear prose and keep the tone factual. If a pet arrives anxious, use the usual calm steps and avoid crowding the carrier. The desk should treat each handoff as a shared duty between staff, handlers, and the flight team.

For the small dog cases on the board, <<FACT F068>> and make sure the crate description in the file matches the inspection note before the case moves on. If Mina Haddad or Isaac Wilson appears in a review, keep the language simple and record only what is needed for the file. Maple may be listed in the pet notes, and any observation about behavior should stay brief, humane, and objective. Escalation remains a stepwise review, and any concern should move through the proper channel without delay or added comment.

Before a case leaves the desk, <<FACT F092>> and then confirm that the hand-off note is complete, readable, and placed with the travel papers. Please continue to check each folder for missing signatures, mismatched crate details, or unclear handling remarks. Aurelia Skyways relies on accurate records from the Companion Animal Travel Desk, and the team should keep every entry clean, current, and ready for the next shift. Thank you for the steady work and the careful attention shown today.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
